wordProblems.q: Mason has 24 balloons. Mason buys twice as many balloons as Mason already has, plus 9 more. How many balloons does Mason have now?
Lily, Owen and Liam each have 5 pencils. Their teacher gives them 4 more pencils to share. How many pencils do they have in all?
Zoe has 26 stickers. Zoe gives away 16 stickers, then buys 4 packs with the same number of stickers left in each pack. How many stickers does Zoe buy?
There are 54 red cars and 23 blue cars in a car park. 42 cars drive away. How many cars are left in the car park?
A ticket costs $7. Isabella buys 3 tickets and a snack for $15. How many dollars does Isabella spend in all?
Zoe buys 5 packs of 6 pens and 4 packs of 5 pencils. How many pens and pencils does Zoe buy in all?
66 children go on a school trip. 12 children ride in the first bus. The rest ride in the second bus. How many children ride in the second bus?
A baker makes 6 trays with 10 cookies on each tray. Her family eats 13 cookies. How many cookies are left?
Adam plants 8 rows of carrots with 9 carrots in each row. Then Adam plants 6 more carrots. How many carrots did Adam plant in all?
Ben saves $5 every week for 3 weeks. Then Ben spends $6 on a game. How many dollars does Ben have left?
A library has 4 shelves with 8 books on each shelf. The librarian adds 8 more books. How many books are there in all?
A shop has 4 boxes with 8 apples in each box. The shop sells 17 apples. How many apples are left?
Layla has 50 red beads and 24 blue beads. Layla uses 40 beads to make a necklace. How many beads does Layla have left?
A cook has 3 cartons with 12 eggs in each carton. She uses 15 eggs to bake cakes. How many eggs are left?
Liam scores 34 points in the first game and 18 points in the second game. Liam gets 15 bonus points. How many points does Liam have in all?
A farmer fills 5 baskets with 7 oranges in each basket. He gives 23 oranges to his neighbours. How many oranges are left?
Nora is reading a book with 82 pages. Nora reads 32 pages on Monday and 41 pages on Tuesday. How many pages are left to read?
A class has 6 groups with 8 children in each group. 37 children are away today. How many children are at school?
Isabella has 3 bags with 5 marbles in each bag. Isabella gives 4 marbles to a friend. How many marbles does Isabella have left?
A baker packs 3 boxes with 7 cookies in each box. Then she bakes 7 more cookies. How many cookies are there in all?
A shop has 3 crates with 6 bottles of juice in each crate. The shop sells 10 bottles. How many bottles are left?
Sophia scores 32 points on Monday, 16 points on Tuesday and 11 points on Wednesday. How many points does Sophia score in all?
Lucas plants 8 rows of beans with 8 seeds in each row. 49 seeds grow into plants. How many seeds do not grow?
An adult ticket costs $10 and a child ticket costs $5. Emma buys 3 adult tickets and 4 child tickets. How many dollars does Emma spend in all?
Zoe is reading a book with 76 pages. Zoe reads 14 pages on Friday and 40 pages on Saturday. How many pages are left to read?
A market has 6 baskets with 9 apples in each basket and 3 baskets with 9 pears in each basket. The market sells 51 pieces of fruit. How many pieces of fruit are left?
A cook bakes 3 trays with 8 cupcakes on each tray. The children eat 12 cupcakes. How many cupcakes are left?
Chloe has $53. Chloe buys a ball for $9 and a hat for $19. How many dollars does Chloe have left?
Isabella fills 3 jars with 5 strawberries in each jar. Then Isabella picks 8 more strawberries. How many strawberries does Isabella have in all?
Adam saves $10 every week for 3 weeks. Then Adam buys a kite for $8 and a puzzle for $6. How many dollars does Adam have left?
